cards.title: Women shouldn't travel hours to give birth
cards.body: Hospital closures in Devon and Cornwall are putting pregnant women's lives at risk. Readers share concerns about maternity access during pregnancy and childbirth.

cards.title: How surrogacy helped my family
cards.body: A reader shares personal experience with surrogacy as a path to parenthood. The letter responds to broader discussions about surrogacy regulation and ethics.

cards.title: I forgot how to parent a second baby
cards.body: A mother discovers she's forgotten much about infant care after years since her first child. Her own mother's practical help and memories of a carefree childhood prove invaluable.

cards.title: Should AI replace parenting decisions?
cards.body: Tech companies offer eye-movement trackers and 'optimized nap predictions' for parents. The article questions whether parents actually need these technological solutions.

cards.title: The '18 summers' parenting trend trap
cards.body: Modern parenting trends risk turning summer breaks into controlled 'memory-making' exercises. Unstructured time and boredom are actually valuable parts of childhood.

cards.title: Your child's anxiety has a schedule
cards.body: Children's anxiety often follows predictable daily patterns rather than appearing random. Understanding your child's anxiety clock helps identify triggers and manage symptoms effectively.

cards.title: Black families and racial socialization
cards.body: Racial socialization is a crucial survival strategy for Black youth facing systemic threats. Parents teach critical awareness to help children navigate a racially divided world.

cards.title: When adult children's panic drains parents
cards.body: Repeatedly rescuing adult children from financial emergencies can reinforce unhealthy patterns. Breaking the cycle requires parents to set firm boundaries around financial support.

cards.title: 10 things estranged adults hear
cards.body: Estranged adult children repeatedly hear dismissive messages like 'you didn't try hard enough.' Understanding these harmful narratives helps validate difficult family separation decisions.

cards.title: Women in politics on motherhood
cards.body: High-profile women discuss the impossible standard of 'having it all' as mothers and professionals. Some are making difficult choices about career and family timing.
